name: iiit-pune-campus-connect
description: IIIT Pune Campus Connect - Emergency Response Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run db:generate
scripts.db:setup: cd backend && npx prisma db push && npm run db:seed
scripts.build:deploy: npm run build && npm run db:setup
